correctness.rationale: Theorem 1.3 and (1.4c–h) give the numerator on the product-coordinate slice s=t. With k=j+1 and h=floor((4k−1)/m), the original L(j)=k−h and κ(j)+1=m(h+1)−4k. Thus the four exponents after normalization are h,h+1,h+4,h+5, and the central monomial is m²s⁴; this verifies the link to the original kernel. On each residue class the coefficients of these sums are polynomials of degree at most three in n (sum a quadratic in k over linear endpoints). An independent integer evaluation of all coefficients at n=3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17 gives equality with the lifted quartic and the stated shifted coefficient factors at four indices per class, sufficient by the degree bound. An independent Bernstein conversion gives minimum coefficients multiplied by 12 on [-2,-1],[-1,0],[0,1],[1,2] of (1152,1152,1008,9396) for B, (768,768,696,2460) for C1, and (768,768,648,2388) for C3. The x=2+t monomial coefficients are also strictly positive. Since F≥0 for x≥−2, there are no real zeros there. In t=−x−2 the coefficient signs are +,+,−,−,+, and the IVT crossings on either side of x=−4 force exactly two simple negative transformed roots, with a remaining simple conjugate pair. The reciprocal lift gives a simple interior and exterior root for each since no transformed root lies in [−2,2]. At x=−4 the implicit balance is x+4=−51/n²+O(n⁻³); lifting gives the stated persistent-root correction. At x=−2 it is x+2=−12/n²+O(n⁻³); the interior inverse has s+1 positive and asymptotic to sqrt(−x−2). At x=0 the rescaling x=u/n has simple limiting roots u=±2i√3. The derivative of s+s⁻¹ at ±i is 2, so the inward signs give the displayed conjugate branches. Analyticity on each residue and their common leading coefficients justify the stated remainders for all odd n. Every 0<|s|<1 is realized on the product-coordinate slice by taking both coordinates of each point to have modulus sqrt(|s|) and choosing their relative phase; the original denominator does not vanish there. This is not the Hermitian diagonal z=w. The frozen script was inspected, not executed; its sample checks for some shifted signs are not the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Unit-circle nonvanishing cannot distinguish an interior negative root staying away from the boundary from one tending to −1, or provide the different inward speeds at −1 and ±i. The uniform simplicity, finite real/nonreal split, and explicit displacement laws supply useful information about the kernel slice in a natural fixed-gap family. Neither the qualitative count nor information about the full kernel zero variety is taken as a new contribution.
